verdict.rationale: Formant advertises a natural-language interface where users can 'ask your fleet what's happening in plain language and get governed, ML-driven task recommendations,' but execution explicitly requires human approval ('with people approving what happens next'), not autonomous platform planning/execution as the story describes. This is a marketing-page mention with no technical documentation of the underlying NL-to-plan pipeline or execution semantics. Missing for 10: technical docs on the NL planning engine, evidence of autonomous execution without human gating, and independent/hands-on verification of the feature.
